# OpenPatent (openpatent.ai)

> Open patent evidence for AI innovations — prior-art anchoring and defensive publication.

Every artifact MEOK's agent hive produces is captured as a tamper-evident invention disclosure: a content fingerprint, a hash-chained cryptographic receipt, and an optional publicly-verifiable proofof.ai / csoai.org certificate.

## What this is
OpenPatent is a vertical in the CSOAI Hive — automated invention documentation with EU AI Act and AI governance attestation support, exposed as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers callable by any AI agent.

## MCP tools
- patent-disclosure-mcp.record: Capture an invention disclosure with SIGIL hash-chain anchoring.
- prior-art-mcp.verify: Verify prior-art evidence and defensive publication status.

## Discovery
- Agent card: https://openpatent.ai/agent.json
- MCP catalog: https://openpatent.ai/.well-known/mcp.json
- Sitemap: https://openpatent.ai/sitemap.xml
- Hive registry: https://csoai.org

## Trust spine
- Sign a disclosure: https://os.meok.ai/api/sign
- Verify any attestation: https://os.meok.ai/api/verify
